title: The saffron harbour
alt: An ochre fishing boat is moored to a stone quay beneath a sunlit terracotta harbour town.
description: Rich oil-painted texture, connected mooring details and a deep architectural composition.
prompt: A richly textured oil painting of a working Mediterranean harbour at sunrise. A small ochre fishing boat with a single mast is tied to a stone quay in the foreground, its ropes visibly connecting to quay bollards. Behind it, layered terracotta buildings, pale sails, market awnings and distant cliffs create a deep panoramic composition. Thick confident paint, subtle reflected amber light on blue water, coherent boat construction and architecture, no readable text or oversized people.
